Dark Temple'' |writer=[[Matthew Rosenberg]]{{SW|url=news/star-wars-jedi-fallen-order-comic|text=''Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order - Dark Temple'', a Prequel Comic to the Game, Is Coming This September}} |penciller=[[Paolo Villanelli]] |inker= |letterer= |colorist= |cover artist= |editor= |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |start date=[[September 4]], [[2019]]{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/45706-marvel-comics-september-2019-solicitations.html|text=MARVEL COMICS September 2019 Solicitations|date=2019-06-20|archivedate=20190714115547}} |end date=[[December 4]], 2019{{WebCite|url=https://comicspit.com/2019/09/18/marvel-comics-december-2019-solicitations|text=Marvel Comics December 2019 Solicitations|date=2019-09-19|archivedate=20200811191617}} |schedule= |format=Miniseries |issues=5 |timeline=*[[14 BBY]] {{C|frame story}}The frame story of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple]]'' takes place concurrently with ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''. The events of ''Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order'' take place about five [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, it can be deduced that the events of ''Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order'' and ''Star Wars: Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple'' take place around [[14 BBY]]. *[[41 BBY]] {{C|flashback story}}''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the flashbacks in the miniseries to [[41 BBY]]. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} {{Quote|Cere Junda and Eno Cordova are a pair of Jedi that fans are definitely going to want to know more about, and this comic will tell you part of their story you won't get anywhere else.|Matthew Rosenberg|}} '''''Star Wars: Jedi Fallen Order - Dark Temple''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries published by [[Marvel Comics]]. The series, written by [[Matthew Rosenberg]] with art by [[Paolo Villanelli]], is a prequel to the [[Respawn Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''.
